温.reading: オン, あたた(かい), あたた(まる)
温.meaning: warm, temperature — 温泉 (hot spring), 温度 (temperature), 温かい (warm)
温.label: i-adjective

重.reading: ジュウ, チョウ, おも(い), かさ(ねる), え
重.meaning: heavy, important, layers — 重い (heavy), 重要 (important), counter for layers (一重)
重.label: i-adjective

北.meaning: north — 北海道 (Hokkaido), 北口 (north exit), 東北 (Tōhoku)
北.label: direction

海.meaning: sea, ocean — 海 (sea), 北海道 (Hokkaido), 海外 (overseas)
海.label: noun

道.reading: ドウ, トウ, みち
道.meaning: road, way, path, the Way — 道 (road), 北海道, 道具 (tool), 柔道 (judo)
道.label: noun

悪.reading: アク, オ, わる(い)
悪.meaning: bad, evil, wicked — 悪い (bad), 悪魔 (devil), 最悪 (the worst)
悪.label: i-adjective

広.meaning: wide, spacious, broad — 広い (spacious), 広告 (advertisement), 広島 (Hiroshima)
広.label: i-adjective

青.reading: セイ, ショウ, あお(い)
青.meaning: blue (traditionally also green for natural things) — 青い (blue), 青信号 (green traffic light), 青年 (youth)
青.label: color

色.reading: ショク, シキ, いろ
色.meaning: color — 色 (color), 黄色 (yellow), 景色 (scenery)
色.label: noun

緑.reading: リョク, ロク, みどり
緑.meaning: green — 緑 (green/greenery), 新緑 (fresh greenery). Modern 'green' as a color word, separate from 青
緑.label: color

欲.reading: ヨク, ほ(しい), ほっ(する)
欲.meaning: want, desire, greed — 欲しい (want), 欲望 (desire), 食欲 (appetite)
欲.label: i-adjective

活.meaning: lively, activity, life — 生活 (lifestyle/daily life), 活発 (lively), 活動 (activity)
活.label: noun

富.meaning: wealth, abundant, rich — 富士山 (Mt. Fuji), 豊富 (abundant), 富 (wealth)
富.label: noun

士.meaning: gentleman, scholar, samurai, professional — 富士山, 武士 (samurai), 弁護士 (lawyer)
士.label: noun-suffix

辛.reading: シン, から(い), つら(い)
辛.meaning: spicy, hot (taste); painful, hard — exception trap: same kanji, two readings — 辛い(からい) = spicy, 辛い(つらい) = painful/tough emotionally
辛.label: i-adjective

込.meaning: crowded, included, put into — kokuji (Japan-made kanji, no on-reading). 込む (crowded), 申し込む (to apply)
込.label: verb

漢.meaning: Han Chinese, fellow, man — 漢字 (kanji), 漢方 (Chinese medicine), 痴漢 (groper)
漢.label: noun

字.meaning: character, letter, writing — 漢字 (kanji), 文字 (もじ, character), 数字 (number/digit)
字.label: noun

目.meaning: eye; also ordinal suffix (一つ目 = the 1st one) — 目 (eye), 注目 (attention), 目的 (purpose)
目.label: noun

閣.meaning: tower, pavilion, cabinet (government) — 内閣 (cabinet), 金閣寺 (Golden Pavilion), 銀閣寺 (Silver Pavilion)
閣.label: noun

美.reading: ビ, ミ, うつく(しい)
美.meaning: beautiful — 美しい (beautiful), 美術館 (art museum), 美人 (beautiful person)
美.label: i-adjective

疲.meaning: get tired, worn out — 疲れる (to get tired), 疲労 (fatigue), お疲れ様 (good work / thanks for your hard work)
疲.label: verb

楽しい.meaning: fun, enjoyable, pleasant — speaker's own enjoyment. Contrast with 面白い (interesting/amusing)
楽しい.label: i-adjective

便利.meaning: convenient, handy — exception trap: ends in り but is a な-adjective (便利な物, 便利に使う). Opposite: 不便 (ふべん, inconvenient)
便利.label: na-adjective

安い.meaning: cheap, inexpensive — opposite: 高い. Also note 安 means 'safe/peace' (e.g. 安心)
安い.label: i-adjective

熱い.meaning: hot to the touch, hot (objects, drinks, fever) — exception trap: same あつい reading as 暑い (hot weather) and 厚い (thick). Use 熱い for objects, 暑い for weather
熱い.label: i-adjective

難しい.meaning: difficult, hard — opposite: 易しい (やさしい, easy). Casual short form: むずい
難しい.label: i-adjective

お元気ですか.meaning: How are you? / Are you well? — IMPORTANT cultural note: NOT used as a daily greeting like English 'how are you?'. Reserved for people you haven't seen in a while. Asking someone you just saw yesterday sounds odd
お元気ですか.label: set-phrase

もう一杯いかがですか.reading: もういっぱいいかがですか
もう一杯いかがですか.meaning: Would you like another cup/glass? — polite offering. いかがですか is the polite form of どうですか. Sound change: 一杯 = いっぱい (NOT いちはい)
もう一杯いかがですか.label: set-phrase

そろそろ失礼します.reading: そろそろしつれいします
そろそろ失礼します.meaning: It's about time I should be going — polite way to announce your departure, especially from someone's home or a gathering. そろそろ softens the abruptness; literally 'gradually/about time'
そろそろ失礼します.label: set-phrase
